summary_en: Convano will acquire 37.29 million shares from Dimensional Inc. at 100 yen per share for a total of 3.73 billion yen through off-market transaction, with settlement on October 23, 2026. The acquired shares will be cancelled except those needed for fractional share buyback requests.
summary_jp: ディメンショナルから3,729万株を1株100円で取得する。取得総額は37億2,896万円。相対取引により10月23日に決済予定。取得後、単元未満株の買増し請求対応分を除き、速やかに全株消却する。

summary_en: 37,289,600 shares (5.3% of shares outstanding). Price ceiling ¥100/share. Max outlay ¥3,728,960k. Off-market private sale from Dimensional K.K. (warrant exercise residuum). Execution contingent on 2026/09/30 extraordinary shareholder approval. Acquired shares to be cancelled post-acquisition except as needed for fractional-share buy-up requests.
summary_jp: 37,289,600株（発行済5.3%）。取得価額上限100円/株。最大3,728,960千円。ディメンショナル社との相対取引（新株予約権行使残余）。2026年9月30日臨時株主総会承認条件。取得後は単元未満株買増請求対応分を除き全株消却予定。
